record.original_question: For every dimension d, does there exist an equiangular tight frame in C^d with exactly d^2 vectors, equivalently a symmetric informationally complete positive operator-valued measure (SIC-POVM) in every complex dimension?

evidence.quote: It is a well known conjecture that they exist for all dimensions d, known as Zauner’s Conjecture [Zau99]. Conjecture 24 (Zauner’s Conjecture). For each dimension d, there exists an ETF in C^d with n = d^2 vectors.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A finite collection of unit vectors $\{v_1,\dots,v_n\}\subset\mathbb{C}^d$ is called an equiangular tight frame (ETF) if there exist constants $\alpha\geq 0$ and $\beta>0$ such that $|\langle v_i,v_j\rangle|=\alpha$ for all $i\neq j$ and $\sum_{i=1}^n v_iv_i^*=\beta\,I_d$. Equivalently, when $n=d^2$, such a configuration corresponds to a symmetric informationally complete positive operator-valued measure (SIC-POVM): a set of $d^2$ rank-one operators $\Pi_i=\frac{1}{d}v_iv_i^*$ summing to $I_d$ with $|\langle v_i,v_j\rangle|^2=\frac{1}{d+1}$ for $i\neq j$.

Prove or disprove: for every positive integer $d$, there exists an equiangular tight frame in $\mathbb{C}^d$ consisting of exactly $d^2$ unit vectors (equivalently, a SIC-POVM exists in every finite complex dimension $d$).
artifact.status_search_result: Zauner's conjecture remains open in general. Numerical and exact constructions are known in many dimensions, and a January 2025 construction provides putatively complete Weyl-Heisenberg SICs in all d>3 conditional on the order-1 abelian Stark conjecture for real quadratic fields plus a Shintani-Faddeev modular cocycle identity. No unconditional proof for all finite dimensions has appeared.

status_evidence.title: A Constructive Approach to Zauner's Conjecture via the Stark Conjectures
status_evidence.snippet: Construction giving a valid SIC in every dimension assuming the order 1 abelian Stark conjecture for real quadratic fields and a special value identity for the Shintani-Faddeev modular cocycle.
status_evidence.claim: A 2025 work proves Zauner's conjecture conditionally on two number-theoretic conjectures, indicating it remains unconditionally open.

status_evidence.title: SIC POVMs and Zauner's Conjecture – Open Quantum Problems
status_evidence.snippet: No general proof exists for SIC-POVMs in arbitrary finite dimensions, leaving Zauner's conjecture unresolved.
status_evidence.claim: Listed as an open problem on a curated open problems site.
